name: Issachar (Leah's son)
title: Israel's ninth patriarch
summary: Issachar was the ninth son of Jacob and the fifth son of Leah. His name means 'reward' or 'wages', and he became the ancestor of one of Israel's twelve tribes. The tribe of Issachar was known for its wisdom and understanding of the times.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Leah gave birth to Issachar and named him because she believed God had rewarded her for giving her maidservant to Jacob.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Issachar traveled with his father Jacob and the rest of the family to Egypt during the famine to live with Joseph.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob blessed his sons. Issachar was described as a strong donkey that bows under the burden and becomes a slave who must work.

keyEvents.title: The descendants of Issachar are counted
keyEvents.description: In the census in the wilderness, the tribe of Issachar was counted at 54,400 men fit for battle.

keyEvents.title: Moses' blessing over Issachar
keyEvents.description: Before his death, Moses blessed the tribe of Issachar together with Zebulun and spoke of their joy and riches.
